packageRules.description: The donated component. Its own PR, never grouped and never batched behind anything else - this is the dependency the repository exists to track, and burying it in a group is how it goes stale unnoticed. Contrib components are tagged individually and do not share a release number with the collector core.

Collector core modules move in lockstep across two version streams - stable v1.x (component, pdata, processor, confmap, consumer, pipeline) and unstable v0.x (the *test helpers, featuregate, xprocessor). Bumping any subset produces combinations that do not compile, so they go in one PR or not at all.
OTel Go SDK and API modules, likewise released together.
Everything else in go.mod, batched. Low-signal churn (testify, zap, uuid, xxhash) should not compete for attention with the two groups above.
Do not let the bot move the go directive or the toolchain line. Those are deliberate choices - a bump can change language semantics - so raise them by hand.
GitHub Actions in .github/workflows, batched monthly. Pin churn here is noise relative to the Go dependencies.
schedule: before 09:00 on the first day of the month
